ЕДИНЫЙ ФИНАЛЬНЫЙ МАСТЕР-ПРОМТ V12 BILINGUAL RU/EN
«ЛИТЕРАТУРНАЯ ПЛАНЕТА — ПРОБА ПЕРА» / LITERARY PLANET — PROBA PERA

КАНОН
Существующая «Литературная планета» probpera.ru и актуальный main являются
единственной основой Web/PWA, Android и iOS/iPadOS.

ОБЯЗАТЕЛЬНЫЕ ЯЗЫКИ
Русский (`ru`) и English (`en`) — равноправные production locales.

МОДЕЛЬ
PAID_UPFRONT_WITH_OPTIONAL_NON_CONSUMABLES.
SAFE_PAID_BILINGUAL_V1.

ФИНАЛЬНЫЙ РЕЗУЛЬТАТ
S00–S40; BIL-001–BIL-107; 100% Base Edition English; state-preserving
language switch; verified names/titles; RU/EN child/store/legal/support/
offline/web SEO; exact-RC localized screenshots; bilingual owner handoff;
zero owner translation/programming tasks; no automatic production submit,
release, deploy or merge.

ПРАВИЛО ЧТЕНИЯ
Все разделы ниже binding. Более ранний раздел имеет приоритет. Текущие
официальные store/platform/legal требования, повторно проверенные на Stage 0,
bilingual RC и непосредственно перед submission, имеют приоритет над
устаревшими версиями, лимитами и формами. В обычной работе использовать
модульные файлы и 95_STAGE_DOCUMENT_ROUTING.json; этот TXT — recovery fallback.

ФИНАЛЬНЫЙ ИСПОЛНИТЕЛЬНЫЙ МАСТЕР-ПРОМТ V12 OWNER-MINIMAL FINAL AUTOPILOT
«ЛИТЕРАТУРНАЯ ПЛАНЕТА — ПРОБА ПЕРА»

ТРИ ПЛАТФОРМЫ:
- Web/PWA;
- Android: Google Play + RuStore;
- iOS/iPadOS: App Store.

КОММЕРЧЕСКАЯ МОДЕЛЬ:
PAID_UPFRONT_WITH_OPTIONAL_NON_CONSUMABLES

КАНОНИЧЕСКАЯ ОСНОВА:
ГОТОВАЯ «ЛИТЕРАТУРНАЯ ПЛАНЕТА» НА САЙТЕ PROBPERA.RU И АКТУАЛЬНЫЙ MAIN
РЕПОЗИТОРИЯ KOSYAT128/PROBPERA-LITERARY-MAP.

V12 MODERATION OWNER-LOCK:

- Store-facing default name: «Литературная планета»; subtitle/tagline
  «Проба пера» where supported.
- Do not automatically select Apple Kids Category; treat the app as a
  general/family educational product with a protected child mode unless
  the owner explicitly approves a different final strategy.
- Age rating and content declarations cover the entire submitted binary,
  including adult biographies and works.
- Store reviewers must receive durable access, Parent PIN, sandbox IAP,
  offline instructions and account-deletion path without SMS, expiring
  OTP, physical biometrics or owner intervention.
- Store screenshots must come from the exact release candidate and show
  only working, rights-cleared features. The concept collage is never a
  store screenshot.
- Unlicensed Disney/Pixar or other protected assets must be absent from
  the binary and production manifest, not merely hidden in UI.
- Privacy/Data Safety/permissions declarations must be generated from the
  exact code, SDK, backend and native manifest inventory.
- Required sensitive permissions are minimized; narration never justifies
  microphone access.
- The exact RC artifact must pass technical smoke, rights scan, privacy
  congruence, child-boundary tests and store-specific build hygiene.
- Add mandatory stages 28–31: moderation precheck, reviewer dossiers,
  listing/artifact truth, rejection/resubmission readiness.

V12 OWNER-MINIMAL LOCK:

- Read and obey `03B_OWNER_MINIMAL_FINAL_OVERLAY_RU.md`.
- Use `SAFE_PAID_BILINGUAL_V1` as the default first public release profile.
- Collect all nonsecret owner decisions once in `owner-release-inputs.json`.
- Generate one missing-input report instead of asking repeated questions.
- Native V1 is accountless-first unless account/deletion/privacy/review
  gates are already complete.
- One original optional non-consumable is enabled for first review only
  after every store/backend/reviewer gate passes.
- Generate exact store console worksheets, official-API draft upload
  automation and a one-command release-preparation flow.
- Add DSA trader, export compliance, privacy-manifest, Required Reason API,
  Android developer verification and territory gates.
- All upload automation defaults to dry-run and never submits/releases.
- Add mandatory stages S32–S35.
- Final owner handoff must contain no programming task and no duplicated
  data entry.

V12 BILINGUAL ENGLISH RELEASE LOCK:

- Read `03C_BILINGUAL_ENGLISH_FINAL_OVERLAY_RU_EN.md` immediately after
  03B; it has higher priority than the remaining product specification.
- Mandatory release locales are Russian and English.
- Use `SAFE_PAID_BILINGUAL_V1`.
- English means full UI, Base Edition content, child experience, Planetka,
  offline, store, legal, support, reviewer and owner surfaces.
- Base Edition English coverage is 100%; no silent Russian fallback on an
  English critical screen.
- No raw machine translation, guessed official title, changed fact,
  generated real-writer portrait or lost citation.
- English names/titles require authority/source evidence or a clearly
  labelled fallback.
- Cross-language search uses the same entity IDs and cannot bypass child
  policy.
- Language switching preserves the same globe Canvas and semantic state.
- Create English App Store/Google materials and exact-RC screenshots;
  RuStore remains Russian-first with selectable English in the app.
- Add stages S36–S40 and do not complete before S40.

V12 FINAL BILINGUAL QUALITY LOCK:

- Treat Russian and English as equal release languages for the paid Base
  Edition; English is not a thin UI overlay.
- Apply 151–160 in addition to 119–150.
- English editorial base is controlled international en-US; en-GB is an
  optional reviewed metadata overlay only.
- Web/PWA must have approved `/ru/` and `/en/` routes, self-canonical pages,
  reciprocal hreflang, localized sitemaps/structured metadata and a stale-
  translation noindex gate.
- RU/EN legal, privacy, child, refund, deletion and support documents have
  synchronized versions and an owner/legal-approved controlling language.
- AI/MT may draft only; no raw output, child/private/secret material or
  unlicensed source may be sent/published without governance and human review.
- Russian and English support, security, deletion, entitlement and incident
  messages are complete for every enabled English territory.
- Generate and validate 156_BILINGUAL_RELEASE_EVIDENCE_SCHEMA.json,
  157_ENGLISH_NAME_TITLE_EVIDENCE_MATRIX.csv,
  158_TRANSLATION_QUALITY_SCORECARD.csv and
  159_BILINGUAL_STORE_SUBMISSION_FIELD_MATRIX.csv.
- Final handoff must pass independent Russian-owner and English-reviewer
  fresh-reader usability checks under 160.

======================================================================
A. ЕДИНАЯ ЦЕЛЬ
======================================================================

Самостоятельно доведи актуальный репозиторий до законченного
трёхплатформенного платного продукта высокого качества.

Финал должен включать:

1. Полноценную устанавливаемую Web/PWA-редакцию с одноразовой web-лицензией.
2. Android QA APK, Google Play paid AAB и RuStore paid release artifact.
3. iPhone/iPad native project, simulator build и archive configuration;
   archive — при наличии signing credentials.
4. Тот же канонический 3D-глобус сайта, а не новый аналог.
5. Страны, писателей, произведения, реальные портреты, флаги и verified
   тексты из единого источника.
6. Полностью готовый adult UX.
7. Полностью готовый child mode с точным возрастом, Parent Gate и
   оригинальным проводником Планеткой.
8. Paid Base Edition с богатым Starter Set без обязательных доплат.
9. Необязательный магазин разовых skins, stands, full-3D backgrounds,
   accessories и StoryWorld.
10. Disney Licensed Collection как rights-gated optional catalog, скрытый
    до подписанной лицензии.
11. Offline, sync, content updates, rollback и recovery.
12. CMS/admin self-service для дальнейшего развития без редактирования
    runtime-кода.
13. Security, privacy, accessibility, localization, performance, QA, CI,
    store materials, support runbooks и final handoff.

Не останавливайся после документации, skeleton, одной platform, mock store,
неполного child mode или неподписанной сборки. External credentials не
должны блокировать внутреннюю реализацию.

======================================================================
B. SITE-FIRST КОНСТИТУЦИЯ
======================================================================

Сайт — source of truth, а не приблизительный визуальный референс.

Обязательно переиспользуй актуальные эквиваленты:

- LiteraryWorldMap;
- LiteraryGlobe;
- GlobeCameraRig;
- globeAtlas;
- globeGeography;
- globeProjection;
- country picking/highlight/focus;
- writer focus;
- globe edition registry;
- texture and historical-edition pipelines;
- existing materials/lighting/atmosphere;
- MuseumSkyDome;
- MuseumStarfield;
- one R3F Canvas and one renderer;
- Country/Writer/Work domain data;
- Nobel data;
- WriterPortrait pipeline;
- country flag SVG registry;
- verified biography/evidence pipeline;
- book evidence and cover rights pipeline;
- CMS/admin publication logic;
- brand logo, orange/violet palette and typography;
- existing tests, governance locks and release checks.

Запрещено:

- Unity, Unreal или Flutter 3D replacement;
- второй globe engine;
- второй Canvas для режимов;
- iframe/remote site как core runtime;
- screenshot вместо live globe;
- manual mobile copy of biographies/coordinates;
- отдельная mobile fact database;
- generated real-person portraits;
- generated flags;
- invented facts, quotes, dates или works;
- generated covers, выдаваемые за реальные editions;
- автоматический merge;
- изменения main напрямую.

Создай Site-Mobile Parity Gate для IDs, coordinates, editions, textures,
picking semantics, portraits, flags, biographies, works, sources и hashes.

======================================================================
C. ПЛАТНАЯ БАЗОВАЯ РЕДАКЦИЯ
======================================================================

Это не freemium. Нативные production listings платные с первого публичного
релиза. Полная PWA доступна по one-time web entitlement.

Base Edition включает без дополнительной покупки:

- весь core literary archive;
- все основные globe functions;
- search/favorites/history/collections;
- базовый offline;
- child mode;
- Parent Center;
- до четырёх child profiles;
- Планетку;
- минимум 5 included skins;
- минимум 4 included stands;
- минимум 5 included backgrounds;
- минимум 6 rights-cleared StoryWorld;
- accessibility, privacy и safety functions;
- исправления и content updates в рамках поддерживаемой major version.

Нельзя продавать отдельно: поиск, биографии, country access, child mode,
Parent Gate, exact-age filter, basic offline, Планетку, accessibility,
security и исправления.

Google Play paid-status установить до первого public production release.
Если package уже был offered free, не пытаться сделать его paid: создать
зафиксированный owner blocker и новый package strategy. Не использовать
public free beta.

App Store требует active Paid Apps Agreement и ненулевую цену до review.
RuStore application type = Paid. Web/PWA full access = verified one-time
license.

Price не hardcoded. До owner override использовать planning anchors:
- nearest price point to USD 9.99 для App Store/Google Play;
- 899 RUB для RuStore;
- 899 RUB или локализованный equivalent для Web/PWA.
Перед submission перепроверить price points, taxes, fees и территории.

======================================================================
D. OPTIONAL STORE
======================================================================

Разрешены только необязательные non-consumables:

- дополнительные globe skins;
- stands;
- настоящие full-3D/optimized backgrounds;
- original StoryWorld;
- Planetka accessories/outfits;
- curated bundles;
- licensed character packs.

Запрещены subscriptions, ads, consumable currency, loot boxes, energy,
paid lives, pressure timers, fake scarcity и pay-to-learn.

Purchase pipeline:

catalog → platform price → Parent Gate при child context → system checkout
→ store result → backend verification → entitlement → asset download →
checksum/signature → install → apply.

Client callback не выдаёт entitlement. Обязательны pending, cancel,
duplicate, restore, reinstall, app-killed, refund, revocation, family-share
и license-expiry flows.

======================================================================
E. CHILD MODE И PARENT GATE
======================================================================

Child mode — sealed data/runtime boundary, а не цветовая тема.

Обязательно:

- до четырёх local child profiles;
- exact age 3–17 без хранения полной даты рождения;
- derived age band and reading level;
- per-work, per-character, per-scene, per-fact and per-media decisions;
- writer approval не открывает все works;
- separate child indexes, search, recommendations, favorites, history,
  cache, deep links и offline packages;
- policy restore before first content frame;
- deny-by-default;
- Parent Gate для выхода, purchases, restore, external links, age/account
  changes и deletion;
- secure PIN verifier, rate limit/backoff, optional biometrics;
- Back/restart/deep link/purchase callback не обходят режим;
- no ads, third-party behavioural analytics, public child account,
  geolocation, camera, microphone или open generative chat;
- platform age signals могут использоваться как дополнительный compliance
  signal, но не заменяют parent profile и применяют более строгий policy.

Ребёнок не видит price, Buy CTA, discount, paid ranking или licensed promo.
Видит только included либо уже owned child-safe items.

======================================================================
F. ПЛАНЕТКА
======================================================================

Планетка — оригинальный главный герой проекта и образовательный проводник.

Она:

- встречает ребёнка;
- объясняет gestures;
- помогает выбирать страну;
- знакомит с writer/work;
- предлагает age-appropriate journey;
- сообщает только sourced facts;
- помогает offline/error recovery;
- поздравляет без addictive mechanics;
- может быть свёрнута;
- не мешает globe;
- не рекламирует IAP.

Реплики scripted, локализованные и редакционно проверенные. Открытого AI
чата нет. Narration optional, captioned and rights-cleared.

Визуально: рот ниже глаз, крупные добрые глаза, полностью видимые руки и
ноги; face/limbs separate from geographical surface; reduced motion;
география не искажается.

======================================================================
G. ЛИТЕРАТУРНЫЕ И DISNEY-ПЕРСОНАЖИ
======================================================================

Разделяй:

1. OWNER_ORIGINAL — Планетка и оригинальные project worlds.
2. FOLKLORE/PUBLIC-DOMAIN CANDIDATE — только после jurisdiction,
   translation и asset review.
3. SPECIAL_RIGHTS_REVIEW — отдельная проверка source/illustration/marks.
4. LICENSE_REQUIRED — защищённые персонажи и adaptations.
5. BLOCKED — без прав не видны в production.

Disney candidate packs:

- Mickey & Friends;
- Disney Winnie the Pooh;
- Disney Princess Classics;
- Frozen;
- The Lion King;
- Lilo & Stitch;
- Disney Literary Adventures;
- Modern Disney Worlds;
- Disney Animal Classics;
- Disney-Pixar Adventures.

Все Disney records по умолчанию:

legalStatus=LICENSE_REQUIRED
publishStatus=BLOCKED
storeStatus=HIDDEN
assetStatus=NO_PRODUCTION_ASSET
skuStatus=DISABLED

До signed agreement запрещены assets, preview, SKU, marketing, logos,
voices, music, 3D models, screenshots и AI imitation. Public-domain source
не разрешает копировать Disney visual adaptation. Disney не является
блокером Base Edition: приложение выпускается на Планетке, original worlds
и rights-cleared classics.

======================================================================
H. TRUE 3D CUSTOMIZATION
======================================================================

Скины меняют поверхность того же глобуса. Stands and backgrounds —
независимые scene layers. Нельзя remount Canvas или сбрасывать camera,
selected country/writer и semantic state.

Premium backgrounds High/Balanced должны быть настоящими 3D-сценами с:

- geometry;
- depth/parallax;
- PBR materials;
- lighting/light probes/lightmaps where applicable;
- LOD;
- spatially coherent particles/animation;
- memory budgets;
- Economy/static fallback;
- accessibility/reduced motion;
- rights/provenance.

2.5D/static cannot be sold as full 3D. Background switching is
transactional: preload → integrity/compatibility/memory check → shader
warmup → controlled transition → commit → old resource disposal; error
keeps previous composition. Rapid A→B→C commits only C.

======================================================================
I. THREE-PLATFORM TECHNICAL BASELINE
======================================================================

At execution start recheck all versions. Current package snapshot expects:

- existing Node 24/npm 11 repository contract;
- Capacitor 8 current family;
- Android min API 24 unless audit justifies higher;
- Google Play target Android 16/API 36 for new submissions after the 2026
  deadline;
- current Play Billing Library 9.x and backend verification;
- separate Google Play and RuStore flavors;
- current RuStore Pay SDK, not deprecated BillingClient;
- iOS 15+ support under Capacitor 8 unless product/device audit changes it;
- Xcode 26 and iOS/iPadOS 26 SDK or later for App Store upload;
- Swift Package Manager by default where compatible;
- Web/PWA isolated Service Worker scope that does not break public site.

Do not pin stale versions merely because this prompt names them. Record
current official requirements in OFFICIAL_REQUIREMENTS_SNAPSHOT.md and
lock exact versions in code/CI.

======================================================================
J. OFFLINE, CONTENT И SOURCE OF TRUTH
======================================================================

Canonical CMS/database → verified export → Web export → mobile export →
child-approved export → signed/versioned manifest → atomic client update.

Required:

- embedded bootstrap;
- SQLite/structured local metadata;
- filesystem for heavy assets;
- secure storage for PIN/secrets;
- separate child package;
- checksums/signatures;
- ETag/content version;
- schema/minimum app version;
- temporary download area;
- atomic activation;
- previous verified rollback;
- interrupted download recovery;
- storage management;
- low-memory eviction;
- never activate partial/corrupt package.

No manual app-only biography or coordinate edits.

======================================================================
K. NO-AI FACTUAL CONTENT
======================================================================

For real persons, flags, geography, works, quotes, dates and book editions:

- use canonical owner-supplied/rights-approved assets;
- record source, rights, provenance and checksum;
- no generated face;
- no face reconstruction;
- no similar-person substitution;
- no generated flag;
- no invented summary or fact;
- no raw AI translation in production;
- missing portrait → branded faceless placeholder;
- missing cover → neutral typographic card, not fake edition.

Original project art may be procedural or commissioned, but must be
owner-approved and cannot imitate protected characters.

# V12 MODERATION-READY EXECUTION OVERLAY
# HIGHEST PRIORITY BINDING CONTRACT

This document overrides any older instruction that conflicts with store
moderation readiness. It does not weaken the existing site-first, paid-app,
child-safety, rights, security, performance or three-platform contracts.

======================================================================
1. IMMUTABLE PRODUCT FOUNDATION
======================================================================

The existing «Литературная планета» on probpera.ru and the actual current
repository main are the only canonical foundation.

Codex MUST reuse the actual current:

- LiteraryGlobe and globe scene;
- GlobeCameraRig and camera-intent system;
- geography, projection, picking, highlights and country focus;
- globe edition registry and texture/provenance pipeline;
- MuseumSkyDome, MuseumStarfield, atmosphere and lighting;
- country, writer, work/book and Nobel datasets;
- verified biography pipeline;
- canonical real portrait and SVG flag pipelines;
- CMS/admin publication and evidence systems;
- brand logo, orange/violet palette, typography and owner locks.

A second globe engine, copied mobile literary database, AI-generated real
writer portrait, fake flag, invented biography, remote website as primary
WebView runtime, or divergent country coordinates is a P0 release blocker.

======================================================================
2. STORE IDENTITY AND NAME
======================================================================

Default store-facing identity:

- App name: «Литературная планета»
- Subtitle/tagline where supported: «Проба пера»
- Publisher/brand: the verified legal owner of probpera.ru / «Проба пера»
- In-device display name: «Литературная планета», unless an official
  platform length or collision requires an owner-approved localized form.

Do not use an over-30-character title. Do not call the app “official”
unless the developer account and rights evidence prove that claim.
Do not include Disney, Pixar or other licensed marks in the base app name,
subtitle, keywords, icon or screenshots before explicit marketing rights.

The app icon, installed name, store name, splash identity and support
documents must be mutually consistent.

======================================================================
3. TARGET AUDIENCE AND AGE-RATING STRATEGY
======================================================================

The default product strategy is:

“An educational literary application for a general/family audience with
a separately protected child mode.”

Do NOT automatically enroll the entire iOS app in Apple’s Kids Category.
That is an owner/legal/store decision after reviewing the final binary,
metadata, SDKs, external links, advertising absence and future update
obligations.

The age rating applies to the whole submitted binary, not merely child
mode. The review package must disclose potentially mature themes present
in adult biographies or works, including violence, war, death, suicide,
substance use, sexuality, illness, political repression or other sensitive
material where applicable.

Google Play target-audience declarations must match the actual child-facing
experience. The app may target mixed ages only if all child-directed
surfaces, SDKs, data practices, ads absence and parental gates satisfy the
current Families requirements.

RuStore age marking and content declarations must match the actual
application and screenshots.

Create a store-by-store age-rating worksheet from the exact release
candidate. Never choose the lowest rating merely because child mode is
filtered.

======================================================================
4. REVIEWER ACCESS AND TESTABILITY
======================================================================

Every store reviewer must be able to test the entire relevant product
without:

- personal SMS;
- one-time email code;
- physical biometrics;
- owner intervention;
- geo-restricted internal network;
- expiring credentials;
- production payment;
- hidden undocumented gestures.

Provide a stable review account or deterministic review mode when account
features exist. It must not bypass child-safety or purchase logic in
production; it may use sandbox products and a review-only configuration
that is cryptographically/environment gated and absent from normal public
navigation.

Reviewer materials must include:

- exact route to child mode;
- non-expiring review Parent PIN;
- route to adult store;
- route to Restore Purchases;
- sandbox product behavior;
- offline mode instructions;
- graphics Economy fallback;
- account deletion path;
- explanation that the base app is paid;
- exact contents of Starter Set;
- disclosure that Disney candidates are excluded unless licensed;
- any backend or region dependency;
- contact that can respond promptly.

Automated precheck must prove the review credentials work from a clean
installation and from a different network.

======================================================================
5. RIGHTS-CLEAN RELEASE BINARY
======================================================================

The exact release candidate (RC) APK/AAB/IPA/PWA artifact must be scanned for:

- unlicensed Disney/Pixar names where prohibited;
- Disney/Pixar logos;
- film/cartoon frames;
- protected character artwork;
- unauthorized music, voice or 3D models;
- marketplace or fan-art assets without sublicensable rights;
- AI imitations of protected characters;
- generated portraits of real writers;
- unapproved book covers;
- images lacking provenance;
- expired licenses;
- hidden but bundled blocked assets;
- test keys, receipts or private source material.

A record marked BLOCKED/HIDDEN is not enough if its protected asset is
still bundled. Unlicensed assets must be absent from the production
artifact and production content manifest.

Every factual visual asset must have source, rights status, attribution,
territory/platform scope where needed, checksum and editorial approval.
When a writer portrait is unavailable, use the canonical faceless brand
placeholder.

======================================================================
6. SCREENSHOT AND METADATA TRUTH
======================================================================

Store screenshots and previews must be captured from the exact signed or
release-candidate build submitted for review, using real data and real
functionality.

The owner concept collage is documentation only and MUST NOT be submitted
as a store screenshot.

Store materials must not show:

- future features;
- mock prices;
- Disney or other licensed content not present in the build;
- generated writer faces;
- fake book covers;
- screens unavailable to reviewers;
- UI from a different platform or old version;
- misleading claims such as “№1”, “best”, “official” or guaranteed child
  outcomes without evidence;
- competitor store badges/links in another store’s submission.

If optional purchases are shown, screenshots and copy must clearly
distinguish:

- included in paid base app;
- optional purchase;
- already owned;
- unavailable/territory limited.

Create screenshots for the required device sizes from deterministic seeded
states and retain source captures, build SHA, content version and
post-processing log. Only cropping, device framing and permitted
annotations are allowed; do not alter product functionality in the image.

======================================================================
7. PRIVACY, DATA SAFETY AND ACCOUNT DELETION CONGRUENCE
======================================================================

Generate one canonical data inventory from source code, native manifests,
network calls, backend schemas, analytics/crash SDKs, purchase providers,
secure storage, child profiles and support tooling.

From that inventory produce:

- Apple privacy declarations/privacy manifest;
- Google Play Data Safety answers;
- Google Play target-audience and Families answers;
- RuStore privacy/permissions declaration;
- in-app Privacy Center;
- public privacy policy;
- account deletion page;
- reviewer privacy notes.

All declarations must match the exact release artifact. A NoOp analytics
provider is preferred until a third-party SDK is justified and audited.

If an adult account can be created, deletion must be initiable in-app and
through the required public web path. Deletion must remove or anonymize
server data within documented timelines and explain lawful retention.
Local child profiles must be deletable by the parent without creating a
child account.

Do not claim “we collect no data” if IP addresses, purchase verification,
crash logs, account identifiers or support requests are processed.

======================================================================
8. MINIMUM PERMISSIONS
======================================================================

Default requested permissions:

- network access;
- platform billing where implicit;
- secure storage/files required by app sandbox.

Do not request camera, microphone, contacts, SMS, phone, precise location,
broad storage, advertising identifier, background location or unrelated
notifications.

Narration is playback and does not require microphone permission.
If a future capability requires a sensitive permission, add it only after:

1. owner-approved feature;
2. user-visible just-in-time explanation;
3. platform declaration;
4. child-safety review;
5. denial-path functionality;
6. store moderation evidence.

Create a binary/manifests permission diff gate for every release.

======================================================================
9. PAID APP AND OPTIONAL PURCHASE MODERATION
======================================================================

Distribution remains:

PAID_UPFRONT_WITH_OPTIONAL_NON_CONSUMABLES

Before first public Google Play release, confirm the app is configured
PAID. Never use a public free listing as beta.

For App Store, the required paid-app agreement, banking/tax setup and
nonzero app price must be complete before submission.

For RuStore, the application must be classified as paid, monetization
configured and price supplied.

The paid Starter Set must be complete and independently valuable. Child
mode, Parent Center, Планетка, core literary archive, search, included
skins/stands/backgrounds and base offline mode cannot require IAP.

Optional purchases must:

- use the platform-required purchase mechanism;
- expose real localized price;
- support pending, cancellation, restore, reinstall, refund and revocation;
- be server verified;
- not be advertised to a child;
- be absent or clearly unavailable when rights/territory do not permit;
- have review-accessible sandbox configuration.

Do not include a “buy cheaper on website” digital-content link in native
store builds unless current platform/territory rules explicitly permit it
and the final legal/store review approves it.

======================================================================
10. TECHNICAL STABILITY FOR REVIEW DEVICES
======================================================================

The exact review build must pass:

- clean install;
- first launch;
- orange splash without black/white flash;
- local bootstrap with network blocked;
- globe load in High/Balanced/Economy;
- WebGL context loss and recovery;
- background/foreground cycles;
- low-memory asset eviction;
- orientation changes;
- slow/offline network;
- skin/stand/background stress;

- purchase interruption and restore;
- account deletion;
- deep links;
- Android Back;

- large text;
- reduced motion;
- no critical broken buttons.

No endless loader is allowed. A failed premium 3D scene must fall back to

At Stage 0 and again at release candidate, Codex must browse current

Do not freeze this package’s policy snapshot as timeless truth. When a

======================================================================

Create distinct release variants:

- Web/PWA;
- Google Play Android;

======================================================================
14. REJECTION AND RESUBMISSION WORKFLOW
======================================================================

When a store sends a rejection:

1. Preserve the exact original message, rule number, screenshots and
   metadata snapshot.
2. Classify: code, metadata, rights, access, privacy, audience, payment,
   stability, account, policy ambiguity or false positive.
3. Reproduce on the submitted build.
4. Create one tracked remediation issue.
5. Fix the root cause, not merely the reviewer-facing symptom.
6. Add regression test.
7. Update declarations/screenshots/notes if needed.
8. Generate a new build number and artifact checksum.
9. Re-run the complete affected store gate.
10. Respond factually and respectfully, pointing to the exact path and
    change.
11. Never conceal functionality or temporarily disable a rule-breaking
    path only for review.
12. Preserve the rejection ledger for future releases.

Codex must generate draft responses but the owner performs the actual
store communication and submission.

15. NEW MANDATORY STAGES
======================================================================

STAGE 28 — MODERATION PRECHECK
- Run all common and store-specific prechecks on exact RC artifacts.
- Produce age/privacy/permissions/rights/access/screenshot reports.
- Status cannot be COMPLETE with an internal moderation failure.

STAGE 29 — REVIEWER ACCESS AND DOSSIERS
- Create and test reviewer accounts/PIN/sandbox products.
- Build Apple, Google Play and RuStore review dossiers.
- Validate instructions from clean install and external network.

STAGE 30 — STORE LISTING TRUTH AND ARTIFACT MATCH
- Capture screenshots from exact RC builds.
- Validate names, descriptions, claims, prices and rights.
- Prove every advertised feature exists and every licensed feature is
  actually permitted.

STAGE 31 — REJECTION-RESUBMISSION READINESS
- Run simulated rejection scenarios.
- Verify issue templates, response drafts, build-number bump, evidence
  update and resubmission checklist.
- Complete final moderation readiness scorecard.

These stages are required before FINAL HANDOFF.

======================================================================
16. V12 MODERATION DEFINITION OF DONE
======================================================================

V12 moderation readiness is COMPLETE only when:

- real store-facing app name is within current limits;
- legal/publisher identity is consistent;
- target audience and whole-binary age disclosures are complete;
- Kids Category is not selected automatically;
- review access works without owner intervention;
- Parent Gate is testable;
- exact RC screenshots are truthful;
- concept collage is excluded from submission;
- no unlicensed assets are bundled;
- no generated real-person portrait is bundled;
- privacy declarations derive from actual data flow;
- account deletion is implemented where accounts exist;
- permissions are minimal and declared;
- paid-app state is configured or isolated as an objective external
  console blocker;
- optional IAP sandbox and server verification are ready;
- all release variants are store-clean;
- current SDK/target requirements are satisfied;
- technical review smoke passes;
- all three review dossiers are complete;
- rejection/resubmission playbook is tested;
- only objective external actions remain.

Store approval can never be guaranteed by code alone. The required result
is a complete, truthful, stable, legally supportable submission package
that minimizes preventable rejection risk.

# V12 OWNER-MINIMAL FINAL EXECUTION OVERLAY
# ВЫСШИЙ ПРИОРИТЕТ ПОСЛЕ 03_MASTER_EXECUTIVE_PROMPT_V12_RU_EN.txt

Этот документ усиливает V12 так, чтобы после работы Codex владельцу
остались только объективно неизбежные действия: юридическая идентификация,
store/merchant accounts, production secrets, финальное утверждение,
ручное нажатие Submit/Release и ответы магазину.

Нельзя переносить на владельца:

- выбор внутренней архитектуры;
- написание store descriptions;
- ручное составление Data Safety/App Privacy;
- ручную подготовку screenshots;
- поиск путей к Parent Gate;
- заполнение десятков разрозненных конфигурационных файлов;
- создание release commands;
- проверку SDK/permissions;
- поиск причин crash/black globe;
- ручную сборку контентных пакетов;
- ручную сверку rights manifests;
- подготовку reviewer notes;
- составление ответа на типовое замечание;
- выбор безопасных технических defaults;
- повторное изучение всего проекта после лимита Codex.

======================================================================
1. ЕДИНЫЙ OWNER INPUT
======================================================================

Все несекретные решения владельца собираются в одном файле:

`owner-release-inputs.json`

Все секреты передаются только через обозначенные secret stores и никогда
не записываются в этот файл.

Codex должен:

1. Сгенерировать `owner-release-inputs.example.json`.
2. Валидировать его по JSON Schema.
3. Подставить безопасные defaults.
4. Сформировать понятный отчёт только по незаполненным обязательным полям.
5. Из одного файла сгенерировать:
   - app identifiers;
   - display names;
   - store metadata;
   - prices planning;
   - territories;
   - privacy/support/legal URLs;
   - review notes;
   - reviewer routes;
   - owner sign-off forms;
   - release profile;
   - store console worksheets;
   - release commands;
   - submission packages.
6. Не задавать владельцу вопрос, если безопасный default уже определён.
7. Не требовать повторно вводить одно значение в нескольких местах.

======================================================================
2. SAFE FIRST RELEASE PROFILE
======================================================================

По умолчанию первая публичная версия использует профиль:

`SAFE_PAID_BILINGUAL_V1`

Его цель — выпустить полноценное приложение с минимальным риском
модерации и минимальным количеством действий владельца.

Обязательные defaults:

- сайт и готовая Литературная планета — единственный канон;
- платная базовая редакция;
- богатый Starter Set;
- child mode и Parent Center включены;
- Планетка включена;
- offline bootstrap включён;
- no ads;
- no subscription;
- no consumable currency;
- no loot boxes;
- no open chat;
- no microphone;
- no camera;
- no location;
- no contact/SMS/call-log access;
- no behavioural analytics;
- no push notifications in V1;
- no Disney/Pixar assets, names, screenshots or SKU;
- no other licensed pack without complete rights;
- no alternative/external digital checkout link inside native builds;
- one optional original non-consumable product per store only if every
  store/backend/reviewer gate is green;
- otherwise IAP code remains complete but production product visibility
  is disabled without breaking the paid base app;
- account/sync remains disabled for first public release unless the
  existing account system, deletion, privacy declarations and reviewer
  access all pass;
- Russian interface must be complete;
- any additional locale is enabled only at 100% UI/content/store readiness;
- no unfinished locale;
- no Coming Soon cards for unavailable licensed content;
- manual/staged release after store approval;
- no automatic production launch.

This profile does not remove features from the codebase. It controls which
fully validated features are enabled in the first public release.

======================================================================
3. ACCOUNTLESS-FIRST DEFAULT
======================================================================

To reduce review, privacy and owner burden:

- native paid app core is guest-first;
- local favorites, history, child profiles and settings work without an
  account;
- store account handles paid app download and native IAP restore;
- cloud sync is optional and disabled by default in SAFE_PAID_BILINGUAL_V1 unless it
  is already production-ready;
- disabling cloud account must not disable base features;
- account UI must not be visible in production when the feature flag is
  off;
- account-related SDKs and data collection must be excluded from the
  binary/manifest when disabled where feasible;
- if account creation is enabled, in-app deletion and required public web
  deletion become mandatory before submission.

Web/PWA may require an entitlement identity for the paid web license, but
this must be the minimum necessary commerce identity and have deletion,
recovery, privacy and support flows.

======================================================================
4. ONE OPTIONAL PRODUCT STRATEGY
======================================================================

For the first store review, prefer one original, low-risk, small,
non-consumable optional product:

- no third-party character;
- no Disney/Pixar;
- no real-person likeness;
- no questionable music;
- clear visual value;
- small download;
- safe fallback;
- works on all supported devices;
- easy to preview;
- easy to restore;
- no age concern;
- complete rights.

Preferred candidates:

1. Original premium book-stack stand.
2. Original premium 3D library background.
3. Original Planetka accessory bundle.

Codex chooses the strongest production-ready candidate after testing.
Additional products remain disabled until after first approval unless
they pass exactly the same gates.

This reduces the chance that one incomplete SKU blocks the entire first
submission while still delivering a real optional-purchase system.

======================================================================
5. OWNER-MINIMAL RELEASE AUTOMATION
======================================================================

Create root commands, adapted to the repository package manager:

```text
release:owner:init
release:owner:validate
release:owner:missing
release:prepare:all
release:preflight:all
release:review-dossiers
release:capture:screenshots
release:package:all
release:upload:draft:apple
release:upload:draft:google
release:upload:draft:rustore
release:upload:draft:web
release:status
release:owner:handoff
```

Rules:

- all upload commands are dry-run by default;
- a separate explicit flag and available credentials are required for an
  authorized draft upload;
- no command submits to review, releases to production, changes price,
  accepts agreements or merges main automatically;
- commands produce machine-readable JSON and a short Russian summary;
- secrets are redacted;
- missing external values are grouped into one owner task list;
- successful reruns are idempotent;
- partial failure does not corrupt store state;
- each store uses its official API or officially supported upload path;
- an API limitation is documented instead of hidden.

======================================================================
6. OFFICIAL STORE AUTOMATION BOUNDARIES
======================================================================

Apple:

- App Store Connect API may manage metadata, screenshots, TestFlight,
  IAP and submissions where supported;
- binary upload uses an officially supported Apple path such as the
  current App Store Connect build upload API, Xcode or Transporter;
- a new app record and agreements may still require App Store Connect;
- API keys remain secrets;
- no automatic Submit for Review without explicit owner action.

Google Play:

- use Google Play Developer Publishing API transactional edits for
  artifacts, tracks and listings where supported;
- first app record, legal declarations and some console actions remain
  manual;
- do not commit an edit to production without explicit owner action;
- internal/closed track upload can be automated after credentials exist.

RuStore:

- use current RuStore Public API for draft/version/assets where supported;
- respect API prerequisites such as an existing/active app record;
- paid type, monetization, legal verification and final moderation remain
  owner/console actions;
- upload is dry-run or draft-only by default.

Web/PWA:

- generate deploy artifact and merchant configuration validation;
- production deploy remains explicit;
- no merchant secret in source;
- support rollback.

======================================================================
7. OWNER SECRETS CONTRACT
======================================================================

Codex creates a names-only secrets matrix.

Expected secret references may include:

- APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID;
- APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID;
- APP_STORE_CONNECT_PRIVATE_KEY;
- APPLE_TEAM_ID;
- IOS_SIGNING_CERTIFICATE/PROFILE references;
- GOOGLE_PLAY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON;
- ANDROID_UPLOAD_KEYSTORE;
- ANDROID_UPLOAD_KEY_ALIAS;
- ANDROID_UPLOAD_KEY_PASSWORD;
- ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD;
- RUSTORE_PUBLIC_API_TOKEN;
- RUSTORE_PAY_PROJECT/MERCHANT secrets;
- WEB_PSP_SECRET;
- WEB_PSP_WEBHOOK_SECRET;
- SUPABASE/CLOUDFLARE production secrets where actually required.

Rules:

- no value appears in Git, reports, screenshots, logs or chat;
- every secret has owner, purpose, rotation, backup and revocation plan;
- production and sandbox secrets are separated;
- CI gets least privilege;
- store API keys cannot administer unrelated apps where avoidable;
- owner receives an emergency-recovery checklist.

======================================================================
8. LEGAL AND REGIONAL COMPLIANCE GATES
======================================================================

Codex must include a territory decision matrix and ask the owner to choose

Apple/EU:

- DSA trader status must be assessed and verified before EU distribution;

- export-compliance/encryption questions are completed;

- Required Reason APIs and privacy manifests are audited.

Google/Android:

- developer identity and organization verification are completed;
- app/package is registered under Android developer verification where
  required;
- recheck the 2026-09-30 rollout in Brazil, Indonesia, Singapore and
  Thailand and subsequent expansion;
- target API, Billing and Play policies are current;

RuStore:

- developer/organization/EDS requirements;
- paid-app monetization;
- current Pay SDK;
- matching signing;
- personal-data/operator and consumer-information review;
- territory/payment restrictions.

The initial public territory set must not automatically be “all
countries”. It is generated from:

- store payment availability;
- legal/trader/tax readiness;
- rights territories;
- supported language;
- support capability;
- privacy requirements;
- publisher decision.

======================================================================
9. APPLE DSA, EXPORT AND PRIVACY-API CHECKS
======================================================================

Add dedicated Apple gates:

- DSA trader status declared even if EU is not selected, where App Store

- trader contact verification completed before EU release;

======================================================================
10. ANDROID DEVELOPER VERIFICATION
======================================================================

Add a release gate that verifies:

- developer identity;
- organization details;
- package registration;
- signing certificate association;
- app record registration;
- rollout-country requirements;
- no mismatch between Google Play, RuStore and direct/test signatures;
- September 30, 2026 affected-country readiness;
- evidence stored without exposing personal documents.

A verification failure is an external owner/account blocker only after all
technical package/signing metadata and exact instructions are prepared.

======================================================================
11. ONE-TIME OWNER APPROVAL SCREEN
======================================================================

Codex must generate a single owner-facing report:

`FINAL_OWNER_APPROVAL_RU.html` and `.md`

It shows only decisions that genuinely require the owner:

- legal seller;
- public app name/subtitle;
- SAFE_PAID_BILINGUAL_V1 profile;
- price per store;
- countries/territories;
- mixed/family audience;
- Apple Kids Category default NO;
- age rating answers;
- privacy/Data Safety answers;
- app icon;
- screenshots;
- Starter Set;
- one optional product;
- support/privacy/terms/deletion URLs;
- rights summary;
- Disney excluded;
- final artifact SHA;
- staged/manual release mode.

Each item has:

- recommended default;
- why it matters;
- exact artifact/preview;
- approve/reject field;
- no technical jargon where unnecessary.

Owner approval is entered once and propagated to all store packages.

======================================================================
12. CONTEXT-EFFICIENT CODEX EXECUTION
======================================================================

The archive is large. Codex must not reread the entire standalone prompt
on every session.

First session:

1. Read MANIFEST.
2. Read executive prompt.
3. Read 03A and this 03B.
4. Read requirements/stage routing.
5. Read only Stage 0 documents.
6. Persist package under docs/mobile/requirements with hashes.

Every next Stage:

- load only shared invariants plus the current Stage’s routed documents;
- update AUTOPILOT_STATE;
- keep a compact decision log;
- do not duplicate closed analysis;
- do not regenerate unchanged artifacts;
- run narrow tests first;
- run full gates at checkpoints;
- leave a self-contained NEXT_CODEX_PROMPT.

The concatenated standalone prompt remains a fallback, not something to
read twice after modular documents.

======================================================================
13. RELEASE TERRITORY DEFAULTS
======================================================================

Codex generates three territory sets:

- `TEST_ONLY`: sandbox/internal/TestFlight/closed testing.
- `SAFE_INITIAL`: only territories with complete language, payment,
  support, legal and rights readiness.
- `EXPANDED`: later rollout after evidence.

No public release to an unready territory.

For each territory record:

- store availability;
- price;
- currency;
- tax/trader status;
- language;
- rights;
- support;
- privacy/legal;
- child/audience requirements;
- licensed packs;
- release status.

======================================================================
14. FIRST 72 HOURS AND ROLLOUT
======================================================================

After approval:

- owner manually releases or starts the approved staged rollout;
- monitor crash-free launch, purchase verification, content downloads,
  account deletion, support and reviews;
- maintain a kill switch for optional products/content packages, not for
  the paid core;
- no remote behavior that changes app into an unreviewed product;
- pause rollout on P0/P1;
- preserve submitted artifact and evidence;
- prepare rollback or hotfix;
- respond to reviews without exposing child/user data.

Codex must prepare the dashboard, alerts and exact owner runbook.

======================================================================
15. OWNER-MINIMAL DEFINITION OF DONE
======================================================================

V12 is internally complete only when:

- one non-secret owner input file controls all release configuration;
- owner missing-input report is generated;
- owner secret names and setup paths are generated;
- SAFE_PAID_BILINGUAL_V1 profile is implemented and tested;
- accountless-first native core works;
- one original optional product is fully reviewable or safely disabled;
- Apple/Google/RuStore/Web store packages are generated;
- draft-upload automation exists where official APIs support it;
- all commands default to dry-run;
- DSA trader, export compliance, privacy manifests, developer verification
  and territory gates exist;
- exact console field worksheets exist;
- exact screenshots and review notes exist;
- final approval report exists;
- owner action list contains no programming task;
- owner action list contains no duplicated data entry;
- post-approval 72-hour runbook exists;
- context routing prevents repeated full-prompt reads;
- all prior canon, child, commerce, rights, moderation and quality gates
  remain green.

The owner should be left with roughly these classes of actions only:

1. Verify/create legal, developer and merchant accounts.
2. Place signing/API/payment secrets in the specified secret store.
3. Complete one owner input/approval file.
4. Approve legal texts, rights, age/privacy declarations and screenshots.
5. Allow draft upload or upload the generated artifacts.
6. Click Submit/Release in each store and answer reviewers.
7. Merge the final PR after review.

No prompt can remove these external responsibilities, but everything
around them must be prepared and verified.



======================================================================
16. CHILD PRIVACY AND JURISDICTION LOCK
======================================================================

SAFE_PAID_BILINGUAL_V1 keeps child profiles and progress local by default and
disables child cloud accounts, uploads, advertising, behavioural
analytics, push targeting and child AI input.

Before enabling a public territory, Codex prepares the applicable child
privacy/contract worksheet. Mandatory review includes:

- United States / COPPA when applicable;
- EU Member-State consent thresholds;
- France age-15 consent snapshot and contractual/privacy questions;
- UK Children's Code;
- equivalent requirements in every additional territory.

A territory with unresolved child data/legal obligations stays outside
SAFE_INITIAL. This is a legal approval task for the owner only after Codex
has produced the exact data-flow, feature, consent and deletion evidence.

======================================================================
17. FINAL OWNER HANDOFF LOCK
======================================================================

Codex must generate one self-contained `artifacts/owner-handoff/` folder.

A nontechnical owner must be able to find in under five minutes:

- remaining missing inputs;
- secrets to add by name;
- approved artifacts and hashes;
- exact screenshots;
- exact store notes;
- exact fields and values;
- exact draft upload command;
- exact manual Submit/Release path;
- rejection-response procedure;
- first 72-hour runbook.

The final owner action matrix must contain zero programming tasks and no
duplicated data entry.

======================================================================
18. FINAL STAGES
======================================================================

S32 — single owner input, SAFE_PAID_BILINGUAL_V1, secret/signing map.
S33 — DSA/export/privacy APIs, Android verification, child jurisdiction
and SAFE_INITIAL territory approval.
S34 — one-command release preparation and dry-run/draft API packages.
S35 — owner approval, self-contained handoff, manual submission/release
instructions and 72-hour operations.

FINAL HANDOFF is forbidden before S35.

# V12 BILINGUAL ENGLISH FINAL OVERLAY / ДВУЯЗЫЧНЫЙ ФИНАЛЬНЫЙ КОНТРАКТ
# HIGHEST PRIORITY AFTER 03B / ВЫСШИЙ ПРИОРИТЕТ ПОСЛЕ 03B

## 1. Final release identity / Идентичность выпуска

V12 extends every V11/V12 owner-minimal, moderation, child-safety,
commerce, rights and site-canon rule with mandatory production-quality
Russian and English support.

Обязательные языки первого публичного выпуска:

```text
ru — Русский
 en — English
```

Release profile:

```text
SAFE_PAID_BILINGUAL_V1
```

This profile is the previous safe paid profile plus a complete English
application, content, store, legal, support and reviewer surface.

## 2. Product names / Названия

Russian:

```text
App name: Литературная планета
Brand/subtitle: Проба пера
Guide character: Планетка
```

English:

```text
App name: Literary Planet
Brand/subtitle: Proba Pera
Guide character: Planetka
```

`Proba Pera` is the stable English brand form. Do not randomly alternate
between “Trial of the Pen”, “First Attempt”, “Pen Test” or other literal
translations. An explanatory translation may appear in About, but not as
another official brand identity.

## 3. Runtime locale behavior / Поведение языка

- Source/editorial locale: `ru`.
- Required release locales: `ru`, `en`.
- Unsupported system locale fallback: `en`.
- On devices with Russian as preferred language, start in Russian.
- On other devices, start in English.
- Always provide a visible language selector in onboarding and Settings.
- A language change preserves the same globe, camera, country, writer,
  work, child profile, purchase state, download and route.
- Language switching must never recreate a second globe or reset Canvas.
- The chosen app language is stored locally before first content render,
  preventing Russian/English flash.
- Child mode remains child mode after language changes.
- Parent may lock a child profile language; language selection never
  bypasses age or Parent Gate policy.
- Language and sales territory are separate concepts.

## 4. Complete English scope / Полный английский контур

English is not limited to buttons. Before V12 bilingual release, English
must cover:

- all critical and noncritical UI;
- onboarding, errors, empty/offline states and accessibility labels;
- native system-facing strings on Android and iOS;
- Base Edition writer profiles, biographies, countries, works and facts;
- child biographies, journeys, quizzes and Planetka dialogue;
- Starter Set, skins, stands, backgrounds and optional product;
- search aliases, sorting and transliteration;
- offline packages and downloaded manifests;
- store metadata and exact-build screenshots;
- privacy, terms, support and account deletion;
- reviewer instructions and moderation dossiers;
- admin/CMS translation workflow;
- owner handoff and post-build guide.

An untranslated Base Edition entity may not silently appear in Russian in
an English screen. Publication is blocked or the entity is explicitly
unavailable in English until approved. V12 release requires 100% Base
Edition English coverage.

## 5. No low-quality machine translation / Запрет сырого машинного перевода

Codex may generate a draft, but production publication requires:

1. source hash and immutable factual source;
2. glossary and translation-memory pass;
3. named-entity/title verification;
4. placeholder/markup/citation parity;
5. independent semantic review pass;
6. back-translation or structured meaning-diff check;
7. child reading-level and sensitivity check where applicable;
8. rights check for translated quotations/titles/audio;
9. locale preview and layout test;
10. approved publication state.

Raw automated translation, hallucinated English book titles, invented
writer aliases, translated URLs, changed dates or lost citations are P0
release blockers.

## 6. English names and titles / Имена и названия

- Use an established English writer name from authoritative library,
  publisher or reference sources when available.
- Preserve native/original name separately.
- Search includes Russian, English, native-script and verified
  transliteration aliases without creating duplicate writer records.
- Use a documented published English work title when verified.
- If no established English title exists, show the original title plus a
  clearly marked transliteration or descriptive translation; never present
  a guessed translation as an official edition title.
- A public-domain source text does not automatically make a modern English
  translation, cover or audiobook public domain.
- Quotations use a rights-cleared English translation or are paraphrased as
  summaries; do not fabricate a canonical quotation.

## 7. Platform localization / Локализация платформ

Apple:

- app binary supports Russian and English;
- use String Catalogs/native localized resources for system surfaces;
- support per-app language behavior provided by iOS/iPadOS;
- localize App Store metadata and exact-build screenshots for English and
  Russian;
- if a new app record is created, English (U.S.) is the recommended primary
  metadata fallback with Russian localization; if an existing record has a
  different primary language, do not change it without a migration review.

Google Play / Android:

- support Android per-app language preferences for `ru` and `en`;
- include only declared locales in the production bundle;
- provide complete default resources so unsupported device locales cannot
  crash the app;
- use English (United States) default store listing and Russian translation
  for a new global listing, unless the owner approves another existing
  configuration;
- custom store listings require their own manually supplied translations;
  do not rely on automated store translation.

RuStore:

- Russian storefront remains the primary submission surface;
- the app must offer Russian and English selection;
- moderation instructions are Russian with an English backup;
- no mixed-language screen or English-only legal dead end.

Web/PWA:

- localized routes and metadata;
- `lang`, `hreflang`, canonical and locale alternates;
- no duplicate-content loops;
- browser/system locale negotiation plus explicit switch;
- locale-specific offline caches and manifests;
- English fallback for unsupported locales.

## 8. Store and legal truth / Магазины и право

Create separate approved materials for:

```text
en-US
ru-RU / ru
```

Do not publish a localized listing until its binary language, content,
legal text, support path and screenshots are equally ready.

Legal documents define which language controls in case of discrepancy.
The controlling-language clause is an owner/legal decision, not an
automatic translation decision.

## 9. English child experience / Детский режим на английском

Planetka English dialogue is adapted, not mechanically translated. It
must be:

- clear international English;
- age-banded;
- culturally neutral where possible;
- free from commercial pressure;
- source-verified;
- subtitle-complete;
- reviewed for pronunciation and voice rights;
- available offline for the included child pack.

Do not use celebrity or character voice cloning. Do not record or upload a
child’s voice.

## 10. Mandatory bilingual stages / Обязательные этапы

```text
S36 — Internationalization foundation and language switching
S37 — Complete English UI, native, store, legal and support surfaces
S38 — English literary content, names, titles, search and CMS workflow
S39 — English child mode, Planetka, audio, offline and bilingual QA
S40 — Bilingual release dossiers, screenshots, owner approval and handoff
```

FINAL HANDOFF is forbidden before S40.

## 11. Bilingual definition of done / Критерий завершения

- Russian and English core UI coverage = 100%.
- Base Edition English content coverage = 100%.
- Store/reviewer/legal/support English coverage = 100%.
- No raw keys, placeholder English, accidental Cyrillic UI or mixed screen.
- All placeholders, plurals, dates, numbers, currencies and links pass.
- Language switching preserves semantic app state.
- English search finds writers and works by English, Russian, native and
  transliterated forms.
- English child mode has no adult or untranslated leak.
- English exact-RC screenshots exist.
- English owner/reviewer instructions exist.
- Bilingual owner approval and post-build guides exist.
- No internal translation TODO is reclassified as owner work.

Store approval cannot be guaranteed. V12 must eliminate all known internal
localization, content, review-access, rights, privacy and technical
blockers before owner submission.

## 12. Final quality strengthening / Финальное усиление

The following are also binding:

- 151 — English style, international en-US base and controlled en-GB overlay;
- 152 — bilingual Web/PWA SEO, canonical, hreflang and stale-index control;
- 153 — synchronized legal texts and controlling-language decision;
- 154 — AI/MT draft governance, provider privacy and human approval;
- 155 — bilingual support, security emails and future notification rules;
- 156 — artifact-bound bilingual release evidence schema;
- 157 — evidence hierarchy for names, titles, quotations and places;
- 158 — weighted translation quality scorecard;
- 159 — per-store locale field matrix;
- 160 — final bilingual owner/reviewer handoff generation.

Bilingual readiness is not established merely by two locale files. It
requires content, child safety, stores, legal/support, web discovery,
offline, search, native surfaces, accessibility, evidence and operations to
match the same exact release candidate.

## 13. Owner-minimal bilingual rule

The owner must never receive a task such as “translate the remaining text”,
“choose an English title without evidence”, “prepare English screenshots”,
“write English review notes” or “fix hreflang”. These are internal Codex /
editorial workflow requirements. The owner only approves concise completed
artifacts and legal/rights decisions.

## 14. Machine-readable and no-return strengthening

Also binding:

- 161 — fail-closed bilingual release-evidence example;
- 162 — translation-assistance provider registry schema;
- 163 — synchronized localized legal document schema;
- 164 — signed/versioned locale package schema;
- 165 — bilingual factual/translation correction workflow;
- 166 — bilingual commands and CI contract;
- 168 — final bilingual no-return contract.

S40 must validate the example/schema pair and prove that content corrections,
legal changes and source edits propagate staleness to every affected English
catalog, search index, offline package, screenshot claim and store dossier.
